solution:
The correct answer is: "**Referance**".

• The correct spelling of the word is "**Reference**".
 
• The incorrect spelling has an extra "**a**" instead of an "**e**".
 
• "**Reference**" means a source of information or a mention of something. (संदर्भ)
 
 
• **Example**: "*I found a great reference book at the library.*"
